reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited paragraphs (14.8 Personnel — supervision/assignment/subcontracting; 14.16 Freedom of Action — parties free to contract with others) contain no non-solicitation, no-hire or inducement restriction on Customer, supporting the rationale.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected or present for a compliant finding, and none is warranted since the preferred position ('no non-solicit on Customer') is already met.
The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure; they do not indicate a deviation here.

Note for reviewers: this conclusion depends on the absence of a non-solicit elsewhere in the agreement (e.g., SOWs, transaction documents or attachments); the rationale states keyword searches returned no such restriction, which is a reasonable basis.
